title: ElderBench: Benchmarking Autonomous Mobile Agents for Older Adults
abstract: arXiv:2609.04850v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While autonomous mobile agents hold great potential for assisting older adults with smartphone usage, existing GUI benchmarks mainly rely on explicit, goal-oriented instructions and rarely capture the naturally occurring language patterns of older users, such as indirect speech, referential ambiguity, and under-specified requests. This mismatch between benchmark instructions and real-world elderly interactions may hinder reliable agent deployment. To address this gap, we present ElderBench, the first benchmark for evaluating mobile GUI agents in authentic elderly-oriented scenarios. ElderBench is constructed from 249 naturally elicited smartphone tasks collected from older adults across 20 applications. We first characterize the linguistic divergence between elderly instructions and existing GUI benchmark instructions from syntactic, semantic, and pragmatic perspectives. translated_title: ElderBench：面向老年人的自主移动智能体基准测试
translated_abstract: 虽然自主移动智能体在协助老年人使用智能手机方面具有巨大潜力，但现有的GUI基准主要依赖明确的、目标导向的指令，很少捕捉老年用户自然产生的语言模式，例如间接言语、指代模糊和不完整的请求。这种基准指令与真实老年人交互之间的不匹配可能阻碍智能体的可靠部署。为了弥补这一差距，我们提出了ElderBench，这是首个在真实的面向老年人的场景中评估移动GUI智能体的基准。ElderBench由从老年人处收集的249个自然引出的智能手机任务构建而成，涵盖20个应用程序。我们首先从句法、语义和语用三个角度刻画了老年人指令与现有GUI基准指令之间的语言差异。随后，我们评估了主流的GUI智能体和视觉-语言模型……
tldr: 提出了首个面向老年人真实使用场景的移动GUI智能体基准ElderBench，基于从老年人处收集的249个自然产生的智能手机任务（覆盖20个应用），刻画了老年用户语言模式与现有基准指令之间的差异，以促进智能体在老年辅助场景中的可靠部署。
en_tdlr: ElderBench is the first benchmark for evaluating mobile GUI agents in authentic elderly-oriented scenarios, built from 249 naturally elicited smartphone tasks collected from older adults across 20 applications, characterizing the linguistic divergence between elderly instructions and existing GUI benchmark instructions.
